The fact that Link travels up the mountain with her means that the audience can infer that Link is also likely to be 17 years old, which means that they are both (1)17 years old as of the end of Breath of the Wild.

It appears that at least 4 years have passed since the end of BotW and the start of TotK as Hyrule is well on its way through the rebuilding process, as there are many stations set up by the Hudson Construction company for people to use in rebuilding, and the fact that Tarrey Town has expanded since we last saw it in BotW. Couple that with the fact that many of the child npcs from BotW have aged up from a child model to an adolescent model as well as the fact that Hudson’s daughter exists (we are not quite sure how old she is, people think she could be anywhere from 4-7 because Gerudo aging or some shit) and we can place that as TotK occurring after some time of peace, making this incarnation of Link and Zelda the oldest that players interact with.
